jobs.title: Software Engineer - Channel Services
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building robust, secure and innovative solutions and excited by the possibilities of AI and data-driven development? Channel Services is looking for a Software Engineer to join our team.

About the team:

We are a small, high-impact team
with big responsibility,
we own the full stack for DNB's communication services across web and mobile channels. Working in a BizDevOps model
, we sit at the intersection of business, development and operations, making sure our decisions are driven by both customer needs and technical excellence. With lean structure comes real ownership: every team member has a meaningful voice in how we build, ship and run our services. You'll be joining a tight-knit group where collaboration is close, the work is varied, and your contributions are visible.

What will your day look like?

You'll take end-to-end ownership of what you build, from scoping and specifying requirements together with stakeholders, through design and development, all the way to deployment and production operations. No handoffs, no silos. You'll work across the full backend lifecycle: designing APIs, building services, reviewing incidents and iterating quickly on feedback. Because we're a small team, you'll often be the one driving a feature from the first conversation to the last deploy. You'll collaborate directly with frontend engineers, product owners and business stakeholders to make sure what we ship is both technically sound and genuinely useful.

What kind of developer are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who wants real ownership, not just a ticket to close, but a problem to solve. You're comfortable stepping into ambiguity, asking the right questions, and turning business needs into concrete technical solutions. You take responsibility for the full lifecycle of your work and don't wait for someone else to define the next step. At the same time, you're a team player who communicates openly, shares knowledge, and helps the team grow. You thrive in a small team environment where autonomy and accountability go hand in hand.

Your knowledge and skills:

Strong expertise in Kotlin and Java, with solid knowledge of multithreading, Kotlin Coroutines, and functional Programming
Hands-on experience building and deploying production services on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CDK), with deep understanding of API Gateway, Lambda, SQS, ECS, EC2, VPCs and networking
Proven ability to design, build and operate high-performance, low-latency distributed systems, troubleshooting at scale comes naturally to you
Strong data modelling skills across both SQL (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (DynamoDB)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and a DevOps mindset, you're comfortable owning services end-to-end in production
Familiarity with serverless architectures is a plus
Working knowledge of Go, auth protocols, OPA, Kubernetes and K6 is a significant advantage
Fluent in English, written and verbal; Norwegian is a plus
Relevant higher education or equivalent experience

Work location:
Oslo

What's in it for you?

Challenging tasks that allow you to grow professionally, competitive terms, a strong engineering culture, and good career opportunities. We offer good pension conditions, employee terms on DNBs products, insurance schemes, access to resorts in Norway, sports, cultural and other activities plus a wide range of discount schemes. In addition, knowledge and experiences are our most important assets, so you will have the opportunity to participate in courses and conferences such as JavaZone and NDC, both to build your own competency and to represent DNB externally. We also have flexible working hours, extra days off and reduced working hours from May to August (summertime).

Are you curious about the position, and would like to know more about how it is like to work with us?

For questions about the position, please get in touch with:
Department Manager / Sanel Sarajlija / mail:
sanel.sarajlija@dnb.no / phone:
+47 91827881

A job in Norway's largest financial group offers professional challenges in an exciting work environment with many opportunities. DNB strives to create an inclusive workplace where people thrive and feel comfortable. We believe that equality and inclusion boost innovative thinking and collective competency which contributes to create an attractive and flexible company equipped for a changeable business landscape. We are looking for skilled and motivated employees to meet customer needs and to achieve our goals. With so many varied disciplines and exciting opportunities in the future, we are looking for employees with different background, age and expertise. Are you engaged in focusing on the customer, and in addition fit our values: curious, brave and responsible, you might be exactly the person we need.

jobs.title: Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer based in Norway.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
Administer and troubleshoot Datacap Server, Rulerunner, Datacap Studio, and Datacap Navigator, including processing queues, logs, performance, failed batches, OCR issues, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and production incidents.
Participate throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, release planning, and post-deployment stabilization.
Translate business requirements and user stories into technical solutions, estimate development effort, conduct peer reviews, troubleshoot defects, and implement sustainable fixes.
Develop and support integrations using REST APIs, SOAP web services, databases, file-based interfaces, enterprise content repositories, workflow platforms, and business applications.
Integrate document-processing capabilities with enterprise platforms such as IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator where applicable.
Manage metadata mapping, database lookups, document and metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.
Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience, including strong experience with IBM Datacap 9.x/9.1.x.
Strong Datacap Studio development experience, along with hands-on Rulerunner administration and development.
Proven experience developing Datacap rulesets, workflows, tasks, actions, and other custom processing components.
Strong understanding of document capture and intelligent document processing, including OCR, classification, extraction, validation, verification, and image processing.
Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.
C#/.NET experience and a background in developing custom Datacap actions or extensions are highly valued.
Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

Benefits

Remote work opportunity.
Contract engagement with an enterprise-focused technology environment.
Opportunity to work on a large-scale document-processing product with significant technical scope.
Exposure to IBM Datacap, enterprise integrations, intelligent document processing, and modern DevSecOps practices.
Opportunity to contribute across development, architecture, administration, integration, deployment, and production support.
Collaboration within an Agile product engineering environment.
Experience working with enterprise and secure federal technology environments.
Compensation and contract benefits aligned with the engagement and applicable market conditions.

jobs.title: Release Train Architect - Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description

At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.

About Us

Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care.

We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

About The Role

We are now looking for a Release Train Architect (RTA)
to work with Tieto Caretech
healthcare products where you will contribute to simplifying everyday life for patients, professionals and customers. In the architect role you will be ensuring that the architectural and technical decisions taken are aligned with Lifecare strategy, data security and set of requirements.

In this role you will

Design, implement, and verify software architecture with a focus on the bigger picture and product architecture.
Utilize advanced .NET concepts, design patterns, and SOLID design principles to develop robust software solutions.
Lead and mentor teams in web development using WebApi, Angular, HTML5, JavaScript, TypeScript, SPA, and NgRx/Redux.
Apply hands-on experience in the .Net Stack and other frameworks to deliver full-stack solutions.
Implement SOA, IOC, REST API, Microservices, and Event-driven architecture.

We are looking for someone with

10+ years of experience in the software industry.
Proficiency in both English and Finnish languages.
Extensive knowledge of web technologies and patterns.

It would be beneficial if you also have

Experience with cloud development and deployment, preferably in Azure.
Understanding of Domain Driven Development and Test-Driven Development.
Familiarity with C#, Angular, C++, RabbitMQ, XML, WCF, WPF, IIS/Windows services, SOAP.
Knowledge of DevOps, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Deployment.
Awareness of cross-browser compatibility and web standards.
Understanding of OpenEHR.
Experience in the healthcare domain.
Familiarity with integration standards like FHIR, HL7.

As a person we believe you are a team player who takes action and demonstrate responsibility to organize your work and solve your tasks. With our agile end to end development process you will continuously both learn from and coach your colleagues, so communication is important for us. Technology is developing fast, so learning new cutting-edge technologies is something you strive to do.

AI knowledge requirement

AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarising, analysing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).

What’s in it for you?

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.

Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host an annual ‘Keep Learning Week’, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

Could you be our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Teijo Mustonen [teijo.mustonen@tieto.com]

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto

Stay Alert To Recruitment Scams

Tieto only communicates via @tieto.com email addresses.
We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.

jobs.description:
Etsimme Sovelluskehittäjän tehtävään
henkilöä Kemiin ja Tornioon. Tarjoamme mielenkiintoisen ja haastavan tehtävän, jossa pääset vahvistamaan osaamistasi työskentelemällä yhdessä kokeneiden ja omistautuneiden ammattilaisten kanssa keskellä tuotantoa.

Sovelluskehittäjänä
kuulut Chrome and EvoCarbon IT-Solutions -tiimiin. Tuet sovellusten ylläpitoa ja kehitystä tuotannossa, tuet palvelujen ja ratkaisujen jatkuvaa parantamista. Rakennat ja toimitat kyberturvallista ja käyntivarmaa IT-palvelua ja toimit luotettavana kumppanina eri sidosryhmille. Tässä roolissa asemapaikkasi on Kemissä, mutta käyt työtehtävien niin vaatiessa myös Torniossa. Tehtävässä on hybridityömahdollisuus, mutta lähityöskentely viikoittain on tarpeen.

Mitä tarjoamme:

• Maksamme teknologiateollisuuden ylempien toimihenkilöiden työehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkaa. Työaika 37,5h/vk.
• Palkkaukseen vaikuttavat henkilön kokemus, koulutustausta ja lopullinen tehtävänkuva
• Hyvät työsuhde-edut (polkupyöräetu, henkilöstörahasto, liikunta- ja kulttuuriseteli)
• Mahdollisuudet ammatilliseen kasvuun ja kehittymiseen uudessa kasvavassa toimintaympäristössä
• Elinvoimainen ja osallistava työympäristö, jossa ideoillasi on merkitystä
• Yrityskulttuurin, joka arvostaa vastuullisuutta, oma-aloitteisuutta ja itsenäisyyttä.
• Mahdollisuuksia ammatilliseen kehittymiseen ja pätevöitymiseen.
• Mahdollisuuden osittaiseen etätyöhön, joka sovitaan erikseen.

Tärkeimmät vastuut

• Suunnittele, kehitä ja toteuta tuotannon sovelluskehitystä prosessiparannusten saavuttamiseksi
• Sovellusten elinkaaren hallinta omalla vastuualueellasi
• Kyberturvallisuuden parannukset sovelluskehityksen näkökulmasta
• Tuki- ja kehitystoimet sovitun palvelutason mukaisesti tai ylläpito- tai projektisuunnitelmissa määritellyllä tavalla
• Tunnistat liiketoiminnan tarpeet ja mahdollisuudet uusiin tehokkaisiin ratkaisuihin
• Vastuunotto korkea laadun varmistamiseksi ja ylläpitämiseksi kaikilla päivittäisen työn osa-alueilla, esimerkiksi ylläpitodokumentaation pitäminen ajan tasalla
• Työt vastuualueesi IT-projekteissa osana projektitiimiä
• Loppukäyttäjätuki mukaan lukien päivystystyö tarvittaessa

Keskeiset vaatimukset

• Soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. AMK tai yliopisto tietojenkäsittelyn tai tietotekniikan alalta)
• Sujuva suomen ja englannin taito (sekä kirjallinen että suullinen)
• Osaaminen eri kehityskielissä (esim .NET, Microsoft-teknologiat, type script, Java, JavaScript, Python, C/C++) sekä tuotekehitystyökaluissa versionhallintaa (esim. Git). Kehitystyökalut (esim. Visual Studio code)

• Hyvät perustaidot pilviteknologioista (Azure).

• Tinkimätön asenne työturvallisuuteen

jobs.title: Cloud Architect (Azure)
jobs.description:
Grow. Make a difference. Together.

We want to help our clients understand why cloud services can support their growth and how to embark on a sustainable cloud journey. Our strong Azure expertise, combined with our highest-level Microsoft partnership, enables us to act as a long-term and trusted partner to our customers, helping them develop their cloud services securely, efficiently and with cost optimization in mind.

We are now looking to strengthen our team of Azure professionals with an Azure Architect
and invite you to join us in building a sustainable future! Sustainability is one of our core principles, and we have, for example, signed the Microsoft Partner Pledge.

As an Azure Architect, you will design, implement, maintain and continuously develop new and sustainable cloud services for a wide range of customers. Our clients include major organisations such as Valmet, S Group and Varma (customer case).

What is the role about?

We are looking for an Azure Architect with strong expertise and experience particularly in Kubernetes solutions. In this role, you will take the lead in designing and implementing demanding container solutions using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
, ensuring that they are scalable, secure and reliable.

A key part of the role is also strategically planning future technology directions, designing environments that support evolving business needs, and driving innovation through new cloud technologies. You will play an important role in developing business continuity and resilience solutions tailored to container-based applications, guiding smooth migrations and optimising system performance for both current and future needs.

In this key role, you will work with a diverse range of clients across different industries, providing both strategic direction and technical leadership in using container technologies to transform their businesses.

As a professional at Knowit, you will have every opportunity to put your expertise to use while continuing to develop your skills with the latest modern technologies. We encourage experimentation and trying new things, and you can steer the development of your expertise in the direction that best supports your growth as a cloud professional.

Building service solutions based on Microsoft Azure cloud architectures covers the entire journey, from definition and design to development and deployment. You will work as part of client teams alongside other experienced Azure professionals, right at the intersection of technology and our clients’ businesses.

What do we expect from you?

At Knowit, we are all makers at heart: we keep our promises and approach our work with passion. We are proud of our broad expertise and take pride in what we do. Being a consultant at Knowit can be summarized as follows

The ability to present and communicate ideas, best practices, and technical solutions to various stakeholders—from development teams to non-technical audiences.
The ability to see technologies as tools for solving technical problems and delivering value.
A built-in curiosity to learn new things, experiment with new technologies and practices, develop professionally, and share knowledge with others.

In addition to the maker mindset, we expect you to have a genuine interest in the technical side of Azure. One thing all our Azure professionals have in common is the ability and willingness to do hands-on technical work when needed. You are also able to communicate fluently and confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in English
.

We hope you have:

3–5 years of experience with Azure cloud services. This means an interest in designing and defining architectures and/or strong expertise in implementing them. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) is our preferred way of working.
3–5 years of experience in container orchestration, preferably in an Azure environment, particularly in designing, developing, deploying, maintaining and troubleshooting container-based applications and their architectures using technologies such as Kubernetes and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
A DevOps mindset: you understand modern approaches to building solutions using native tools and code, and actively look for opportunities to automate everything from infrastructure to business logic.
Strong expertise in designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines for container-based applications, including Azure Container Registry integrations and the use of Helm package management.
Experience in implementing and managing security practices in Kubernetes environments, such as network policies and security contexts, as well as a good understanding of Azure security tools such as Defender for Cloud.

Skills that are considered an advantage, but are not required:

Experience with Kubernetes monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
Ingress controllers and Gateway API
Azure DevOps and GitHub
Infrastructure as Code experience with Azure Bicep
Experience with GitOps tools such as FluxCD and ArgoCD
AI policies, AI Gateway and MCP servers

What do we offer you?

At Knowit, we value broad expertise as well as the willingness to explore and master new areas. We take pride in our hands-on way of working and our deep technical expertise.

And because we don't want this to be just a one-sided wish list, we want you to have the opportunity to shape your role as an expert and take ownership of your professional development, with our support. Everyone is welcome to be their whole self at Knowit, and we consider a relaxed yet professional working community valuable in its own right.

Here’s what we offer:

A fixed monthly salary of 5000 – 6600€, depending on your skills, experience and capabilities.
A team and community where it is easy to grow and get support when you need it. Our people are at different stages of their careers, and we offer opportunities that challenge and develop both recent graduates and more experienced professionals.
Our People Lead model, which has received a lot of positive feedback internally. We believe that a manager's most important responsibility is to ensure that you, as an expert, have the best possible conditions to succeed in your work and develop professionally.
Time and resources to develop your expertise during working hours, including training, certifications and guild activities. We want to invest in your professional development.
Opportunities for internal mobility. Your work can make an impact across several industries, and working with different customers gives you genuine opportunities to learn something new.
A technology-independent environment. We work with modern technologies, tools and best practices, and have strong technology partnerships with major players in the industry. At the same time, we remain curious, ready to learn new things and willing to challenge the status quo.
Flexible remote and hybrid working arrangements that adapt to different life situations.
An excellent work-life balance. We work on large and meaningful projects in sustainable digitalization, but we also recognize that everyone is a whole person and that there is more to everyday life than work.
A comprehensive range of employee benefits, including lunch, commuting and sports/culture benefits, extensive occupational healthcare, accident insurance, work equipment of your choice, recruitment and sales lead bonuses, and the possibility of temporarily working remotely from abroad.

Interested?

If what you’ve read above resonates with your professional interests and you recognize yourself in the description, we would be very happy to hear more about you!

If you have any questions or would like to have a quick chat before making your decision, please contact our Talent Acquisition Partner, Topias Niinivaara
, whose contact details can be found on our careers site.

Knowit - We are Makers of a sustainable future

Our work community in Finland consist of over 400 IT professionals and management consultants in Helsinki, Tampere, Turku, and Oulu. Our working culture consists of low hierarchies, relaxed and open atmosphere and moreover, of great people.

jobs.title: Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer based in Finland.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
Administer and troubleshoot Datacap Server, Rulerunner, Datacap Studio, and Datacap Navigator, including processing queues, logs, performance, failed batches, OCR issues, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and production incidents.
Participate throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, release planning, and post-deployment stabilization.
Translate business requirements and user stories into technical solutions, estimate development effort, conduct peer reviews, troubleshoot defects, and implement sustainable fixes.
Develop and support integrations using REST APIs, SOAP web services, databases, file-based interfaces, enterprise content repositories, workflow platforms, and business applications.
Integrate document-processing capabilities with enterprise platforms such as IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator where applicable.
Manage metadata mapping, database lookups, document and metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.
Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience, including strong experience with IBM Datacap 9.x/9.1.x.
Strong Datacap Studio development experience, along with hands-on Rulerunner administration and development.
Proven experience developing Datacap rulesets, workflows, tasks, actions, and other custom processing components.
Strong understanding of document capture and intelligent document processing, including OCR, classification, extraction, validation, verification, and image processing.
Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.
C#/.NET experience and a background in developing custom Datacap actions or extensions are highly valued.
Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

Benefits

Remote work opportunity.
Contract engagement with an enterprise-focused technology environment.
Opportunity to work on a large-scale document-processing product with significant technical scope.
Exposure to IBM Datacap, enterprise integrations, intelligent document processing, and modern DevSecOps practices.
Opportunity to contribute across development, architecture, administration, integration, deployment, and production support.
Collaboration within an Agile product engineering environment.
Experience working with enterprise and secure federal technology environments.
Compensation and contract benefits aligned with the engagement and applicable market conditions.

How Jobgether Works

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.description:
Job Description

At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.

About Us

Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care.

We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

About The Role

We are now looking for a Release Train Architect (RTA)
to work with Tieto Caretech
healthcare products where you will contribute to simplifying everyday life for patients, professionals and customers. In the architect role you will be ensuring that the architectural and technical decisions taken are aligned with Lifecare strategy, data security and set of requirements.

In this role you will

Design, implement, and verify software architecture with a focus on the bigger picture and product architecture.
Utilize advanced .NET concepts, design patterns, and SOLID design principles to develop robust software solutions.
Lead and mentor teams in web development using WebApi, Angular, HTML5, JavaScript, TypeScript, SPA, and NgRx/Redux.
Apply hands-on experience in the .Net Stack and other frameworks to deliver full-stack solutions.
Implement SOA, IOC, REST API, Microservices, and Event-driven architecture.

We are looking for someone with

10+ years of experience in the software industry.
Proficiency in both English and Finnish languages.
Extensive knowledge of web technologies and patterns.

It would be beneficial if you also have

Experience with cloud development and deployment, preferably in Azure.
Understanding of Domain Driven Development and Test-Driven Development.
Familiarity with C#, Angular, C++, RabbitMQ, XML, WCF, WPF, IIS/Windows services, SOAP.
Knowledge of DevOps, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Deployment.
Awareness of cross-browser compatibility and web standards.
Understanding of OpenEHR.
Experience in the healthcare domain.
Familiarity with integration standards like FHIR, HL7.

As a person we believe you are a team player who takes action and demonstrate responsibility to organize your work and solve your tasks. With our agile end to end development process you will continuously both learn from and coach your colleagues, so communication is important for us. Technology is developing fast, so learning new cutting-edge technologies is something you strive to do.

AI knowledge requirement

AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarising, analysing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).

What’s in it for you?

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.

Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host an annual ‘Keep Learning Week’, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

Could you be our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Teijo Mustonen [teijo.mustonen@tieto.com]

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto

Stay Alert To Recruitment Scams

Tieto only communicates via @tieto.com email addresses.
We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud | Tieto Blog

jobs.description:
Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.   

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.  

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.  

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

At Simcorp, we support some of the biggest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting, and operations. Portfolio Analysis is a product area within Simcorp’s Product Division which delivers functionality that enables clients to make investment decisions with our Front Office applications.

Portfolio Analysis consists of seven teams (of 5-8 software engineers) across several geographical locations, and we are now looking for a Student Software Engineer to join one of these teams. This is a part-time job with an expected average time of 20 hours per week with flexible working hours during exam periods.

We take pride in contributing to the growth of SimCorp with high quality work, but we also have a very pleasant way of working together where supporting each other is a big part of our relationship. Employees can meet up in SimCorp’s own very popular Friday bar and students throughout the house also meet up on a regular basis in their own community.

What You Will Be Responsible For

In your daily work you will - together with your team:

Take part in continuous improvements of tools and processes on team and individual level.
Understand requirements, discuss solutions, implement, and test the chose solutions

Most of the development is done in C#. While we have a broad range of tasks and experiments, a lot of focus is on APIs as well as on optimizing our test suite.

What We Value

We are looking for candidates who are enthusiastic, organized, and ready to support our engineering team. Our requirements include:

Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Finance or related field (last year of BSc or first year of MSc)
Experience with C#/.NET framework or any other OOP language
Good English skills as it is our corporate language and is used in all communications

As a person, you value:

Learning new skills and improving upon existing ones working with others in the team
Continually looking for ways to improve what we do and how we do it
Openness and are not afraid to speak up or challenge the status quo

We have a lot of experienced colleagues, and you can always count on their expertise while working on your tasks.

Our Benefits

Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work-life balance: flexible work hours, a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP sprints; where you have 3 weeks per quarter to spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.
At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.   

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
Administer and troubleshoot Datacap Server, Rulerunner, Datacap Studio, and Datacap Navigator, including processing queues, logs, performance, failed batches, OCR issues, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and production incidents.

Translate business requirements and user stories into technical solutions, estimate development effort, conduct peer reviews, troubleshoot defects, and implement sustainable fixes.

Manage metadata mapping, database lookups, document and metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.
Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience, including strong experience with IBM Datacap 9.x/9.1.x.

Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.

Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.

jobs.title: Network Technical Architect
jobs.description:
Job Description

Stefanini Group is seeking an experienced Network Technical Architect to join our Hybrid Cloud & Infrastructure (HCI) cluster, within the Infrastructure Services Division.

The successful candidate will design and implement secure, resilient enterprise network solutions across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, covering SASE, ZTNA, next-generation firewalls, SD-WAN, and complex routing.

This role combines presales support for solutioning with extensive hands-on implementation and acts as the last level of support for operational teams. It may include occasional travelling and direct technical discussions with vendors.

Job Responsibilities:

Solution Design and Implementation: Architect, deploy, and migrate enterprise network solutions end to end, including SASE, ZTNA, next-generation firewalls, SD-WAN, and campus and data center networks, remaining hands-on from day 1.
Presales Support: Act as the technical authority in presales engagements, qualifying requirements, designing target architectures, estimating effort, and contributing to RFP/RFI responses, proposals, and customer presentations.
Complex Routing and Cloud Networking: Design and implement complex routing environments (BGP, OSPF, route redistribution, traffic engineering) and cloud networking architectures in AWS and Azure, including hybrid connectivity.
Operational Escalation: Act as the last level of support for operational teams, leading root cause analysis and resolution of the most complex network and security incidents.
Vendor Engagement: Drive technical discussions with vendors and technology partners, including product evaluations, proof of concepts, roadmap reviews, and support escalations.
Documentation and Standards: Produce high-level and low-level designs, migration plans, and operational runbooks; define network standards, reference architectures, and best practices.
Training and Development: Provide training, coaching, and structured knowledge transfer to operational teams and clients on new network technologies and practices.
Continuous Improvement: Continuously evaluate and improve network architectures and strategies to adapt to changing technologies and business needs.

Job Requirements

At least 10 years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and operating enterprise networks in complex, multi-vendor environments
At least 5 years of experience as a network architect, owning end-to-end solution design for large-scale enterprise environments.
Demonstrated ability to perform hands-on implementation from day 1, combining architecture responsibilities with direct configuration and deployment work.
Preferred: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Mandatory: Minimum high school diploma (or equivalent). Bachelor's degree in any field with equivalent professional experience relevant for the job.

Technical Skills:

Expert-level knowledge of routing and switching in complex environments, including BGP, OSPF,route redistribution, and traffic engineering.
Deep hands-on experience with next-generation firewalls (e.g., Fortinet FortiGate, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point), covering design, implementation, upgrades, and migrations.
Strong hands-on experience with SASE and ZTNA solutions (e.g., FortiSASE, Zscaler, Netskope,Prisma Access), from architecture through rollout and day-2 operations.
Proven experience designing and deploying SD-WAN solutions (e.g., Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN, VMware VeloCloud).
Solid experience with cloud networking in AWS and/or Azure, including VPC/VNet design, Transit Gateway, Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute/Direct Connect, and hybrid connectivity.
Strong understanding of network security concepts, including segmentation, IPsec and SSL VPN, IDS/IPS, and Zero Trust principles.
Mandatory 3 years of experience acting as technical project lead, driving the technical discussions with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
Knowledge of network automation and scripting (e.g., Python, Ansible, REST APIs) is considered a plus.

Soft Skills

Proficiency in English for professional communication and documentation.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and multitasking skills capable of handling a vast variety of systems.
Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to stay effective under pressure during critical incidents and escalations
Client Orientation & Communication
Accountability
Adapting & responding to chang
Teamwork & cooperation

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het functioneel en technisch testen

Je documenteert

Je behoudt een helikopterview, denkt vooruit en handelt proactief.
Je blijft kalm en efficiënt onder druk. Je werkt zelfstandig en neemt de nodige verantwoordelijkheid
op.

Wat breng je mee?

Je beschikt over een goede algemene kennis van software testing
en hebt een passie voor IT-systemen. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe verschillende componenten met elkaar integreren en legt vlot verbanden. Je denkt out-of-the-box en zoekt proactief naar oplossingen om snel resultaat te behalen. Bovendien speel je een actieve rol in refinement-sessies, waarbij je de QA-aanpak
al vroeg in het ontwikkelingsproces helpt optimaliseren.

Je bent in het bezit van een Bachelor of Master
diploma, een technische IT-achtergrond is een pluspunt.

opgebouwd in software testing, met een stevige basis in functionele en geautomatiseerde testen
. Hierdoor kan je moeiteloos optreden als sidekick van onze test coördinator.

Je hebt ervaring met het opstellen en uitvoeren van testscenario's en testplannen. Documenteren van testresultaten en opvolgen van defects in Azure Devops.

Je kan risico's en de impact van bugs inschatten en advies geven rond de prioritisering
.
Ervaring met tools zoals Selenium, Postman en SoapUI.

Je werkt graag in een team

bij aan het versterken van kwaliteitsnormen.
Met jouw communicatieve vaardigheden
breng je helderheid, enthousiasme en verbinding, terwijl je het overzicht bewaart.

ISTQB Foundation certificaat

Je hebt reeds eerder in een Microsoft Dynamics omgeving gewerkt (Power Platform en/of Finance & Operations)

Een warme welkom in ons team bij VAB, groot genoeg om van betekenis te zijn, klein genoeg om elkaar en onze business persoonlijk te kennen.

jobs.title: Senior Requirements Engineer Digital Product, 80-100%
jobs.description:
PEAX bietet eine Lösung für automatisierten Dokumenteneingang, intelligentes Document Processing und Weiterverarbeitung in nachgelagerten Geschäftsprozessen. Damit werden unsere Kunden von administrativem Aufwand befreit und erkennen den Wert ihrer Daten. Wir suchen Menschen, die unsere Produktentwicklung mit analytischer Tiefe und einem ausgeprägten AI-First-Mindset auf das nächste Level bringen.

Aufgaben
Das bewegst du

Du verantwortest das fachliche Herz unseres Produkts: das Domänenmodell. Capabilities, Business Objects, Business Rules und Prozesse hältst du korrekt, widerspruchsfrei und aktuell. Und du sorgst dafür, dass sie über Domänen hinweg zusammenpassen.

Aus vielschichtigen, oft widersprüchlichen Anforderungen machst du klare Struktur: Nachvollziehbare Use Cases, scharf geschnittene Anforderungen und eindeutige Akzeptanzkriterien. Dein wichtigster Beitrag ist dabei nicht, jeden Einzelwunsch zu spezifizieren. Es ist zu erkennen, wann mehrere Einzelfälle dasselbe allgemeine Problem sind, und die allgemeine Lösung durchzusetzen.

Du präzisierst Produktentscheide für die Umsetzung: Regeln, Grenzfälle, Zustände und Sollverhalten. Bei komplexen und domänenübergreifenden Themen führst du die Spezifikation selbst. Im Übrigen setzt du den Standard, nach dem im Team spezifiziert wird, und entwickelst die Modellierungskompetenz deiner Kolleg:innen weiter.

Qualität ist für dich Teil der Spezifikationsarbeit und kein nachgelagerter Schritt. Du erstellst E2E-Testkonzepte und Testfälle für deinen Bereich und prüfst Features. Wir sind ein kleines Team, in dem alle die Qualität des Produkts mittragen.

Du bist für die von dir verantworteten Features die fachliche Ansprechperson für Engineering, Design, Customer Success und Sales sowie für Partner, Reseller und Kunden. Du bist auch die Person, die „so geht das fachlich nicht“ sagen kann und dafür gehört wird.

Deine Arbeit startet in der Product Discovery: Bei der Problemrahmung, nicht erst bei der Übersetzung fertiger Entscheide. Zudem bringst du deine fachliche Sicht in Architekturentscheide ein, wo sie Konsequenzen für das Domänenmodell haben.

PEAX baut gerade agentische Architekturen. Du nutzt AI-Tools strukturiert und verantwortungsvoll als Bestandteil unseres Requirement Engineering Prozesses.

Qualifikation
Das bringst du mit

Mehrjährige Senior-Erfahrung als Requirements Engineer, Business Analyst oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im B2B-SaaS-Produktumfeld, idealerweise in einer Scale-up-Phase und mit Hintergrund in Document Management, ECM, Workflow-Automatisierung oder einem verwandten Information-Hub-Umfeld. Du hast dabei nachweisbar Verantwortung für fachliche Modelle getragen und nicht nur für Spezifikationsdokumente.

Ausbildungshintergrund in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Business Engineering, BWL mit IT-Affinität (FH, Universität). MSc-Niveau ideal, Bachelor mit entsprechender Senior-Erfahrung ebenfalls möglich.

Echte Modellierungstiefe: Du kannst ein Geschäftsproblem in Entitäten, Zustände, Regeln und Prozesse zerlegen, so dass das Ergebnis widerspruchsfrei ist. Du formulierst Akzeptanzkriterien so, dass sie prüfbar sind. Sicherer Umgang mit BPMN, UML, Use Cases und User Stories sowie mit Jira und Confluence. Kenntnisse in ArchiMate sind ein Pluspunkt.

Generalisierungsinstinkt: Du erkennst, wann mehrere Einzelfälle dasselbe allgemeine Problem sind, und setzt die allgemeine Lösung durch. Du fragst nach dem Problem, bevor du nach der Lösung fragst, und du kannst eine Anforderung auch ablehnen.

Eingehendes Verständnis für administrative Prozesse in KMU, die Aufbereitung von Daten und zur Verfügungstellung via Schnittstellen an Drittanwendungen. Damit zusammenhängend die Fähigkeit, Problemstellen in bestehenden Prozessen zu analysieren und durch intelligente Abläufe zu ersetzen.

Hohe Affinität zu AI-Tools, idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit AI-gestützter Spezifikationsarbeit, Prompt Engineering oder agentischen Systemen aus Produkt-Sicht.

Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau, Englisch verhandlungssicher (C1). Sicheres Auftreten auf C-Level.

jobs.title: Fleet & Device Engineer
jobs.description:
IN SHORT

Are you ready to own the edge runtime for thousands of smart fridges and coffee machines across Switzerland and the US? As our new Fleet & Device Engineer
(100%) in Zurich, you will join a close-knit 8-person engineering team to rebuild and manage the systems that power our hardware. In this hybrid role, you will take full ownership of our edge domain from day one, ensuring that our unglamorous but highly reliable hardware works seamlessly for real people getting their lunch every day.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Take full, end-to-end ownership of the edge runtime on our smart fridges and Gavetti coffee machine controllers, managing everything from zero-touch provisioning, device bootstrap, call-home and on-device applications.
Drive the consolidation of our fleet management onto a single, reliable platform (such as Azure IoT Hub or KubeEdge), taking charge of making and defending the architectural choices.
Streamline the technology stack by reducing the number of languages running on the edge, bringing the device world closer to our cloud environment.
Collaborate closely with and report directly to the Head of Engineering to specify the next generation of hardware, select vendors, and define software contracts.
Inherit and manage crucial vendor relationships and integrations, including those for our vendors and various badge reader suppliers.
Ensure the team maintains a grounded, honest understanding of what is actually running and performing in the field.

YOUR PROFILE

Solid background with roughly 5+ years of experience building and operating production systems, specifically managing a real fleet of devices with live users, outages, and OTA updates.
Proficiency in at least two of the following languages: C#, Go, or Kotlin, coupled with a willingness to consolidate and standardize our tech stack.
Working knowledge of edge platform networking (VPNs, NAT, flaky links, office networks), running Linux and Android on small hardware, OS-level debugging, and observability for offline-tolerant systems.
Strong ability to treat hardware as an interface, including practical experience with Modbus, USB, serial connections, reading sensor datasheets, and working with vendor SDKs.
Familiarity with tools like Balena, Azure IoT Hub, KubeEdge, Kubernetes, Docker, or experience in commercial appliance ecosystems is a strong plus.
Pragmatic problem-solving mindset with a track record of putting the problem before the programming language, preferring standard, reliable tools over inventing custom solutions.
Fluency in English, German is nice to have
Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.
Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

OUR BENEFITS

Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true
Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine
5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation
Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day
We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund
New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.
We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard
Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing
Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions

Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either German or English.

ABOUT US

FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality.
With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;).

FELFEL is a family business that was founded in 2013. Today, we take care of around 1000 locations in Switzerland, and have 150 employees across our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York.

jobs.description:

The Gametech Innovation team
is a specialized group of developers focused on empowering Gameloft’s game teams to create better games through innovative technological solutions. We focus on Unity and Unreal engines, developing tools and systems that span a wide range of game development needs.

As a Mid-Level Developer
within the team, you will manage feature delivery and support the technical stability of our tools and systems, contributing to the full lifecycle of each solution.

What it means on a daily basis

Own features or subsystems end-to-end, from benchmarking existing solutions and prototyping alternatives through to implementing and shipping the final tool to game teams
Write maintainable, self-explanatory code in C++ and C# within Unreal and Unity engines
Debug and profile tools and systems across engines and target platforms (console, PC, mobile) so they stay reliable in production
Maintain and extend the team's CI/CD and build pipelines so new tool versions reach game teams continuously
Use AI coding assistants in your daily workflow, experiment with new approaches and technologies, and propose the incremental improvements worth industrialising

What success will look like

In your first three months, you will be at ease in the team's codebase and delivering fixes and features on existing tools with limited guidance. From there, you will own a feature or subsystem end-to-end, you will propose improvements to tools and workflows on your own initiative and become a technical point of contact for the game teams we support.

Who you would be working with

You will be reporting to our Gametech Innovation Manager, and collaborate very closely with other Developers from the Gametech Innovation team across multiple studios worldwide, including Paris, Montreal, Bucharest, and others, offering opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and perspectives. Day to day you will work with game programmers, technical artists and producers on Gameloft's game teams internationally.

Your recruitment journey

First interview: A conversation to explore how the role aligns with your background and to address your main questions.
Test: You will receive a short case study to complete.
Second interview: You will meet members of our technical team to present your test and talk through your approach, reasoning, and methodologies in more depth.
Final interview: You will meet a Hiring Manager to discuss your experience, vision, and how you approach game technology topics at a broader level.

Where this role can take you

This role can be a stepping stone toward a more senior position within the Gametech Innovation team, or toward specialising in a particular area such as engine, pipeline or platform technology. Internal training and mentoring from the team's senior developers are available, and internal mobility across teams and studios is possible through Gameloft's Talent Move programme.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Solid proficiency with Unreal Engine and/or Unity; and in C++ and C#
Practical use of AI coding assistants in your day-to-day development work
Good debugging and profiling skills across multiple systems, together with the ability to write clean, maintainable and self-explanatory code
Working knowledge of CI/CD and build pipelines

WHO YOU ARE

Naturally curious: you enjoy digging into unfamiliar problems and exploring new engines, tools and approaches
Solution-driven: you turn ambiguous, poorly defined requests into workable technical paths, treat constraints as problems to solve, and propose improvements beyond your assigned scope to keep the team moving forward

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU​

Permanent contract, full-time employment with comprehensive Social Benefits.
25 vacation days per year + Birthday day off.
Private medical health insurance.
Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
Free language courses.
Work-from-home hybrid model.
Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.

Our Barcelona studio offers real career development opportunities and a positive working environment in a centrally located office. We value supportive working conditions and a balanced work-life approach, and our teams work together with a collaborative mindset.

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description:
Tu misión en Netquest

Buscamos incorporar a nuestro equipo a un/a Ingeniero/a de QA de nivel intermedio/senior
, con experiencia y una actitud muy proactiva. En este puesto, serás responsable de diseñar, crear y mantener frameworks de automatización de pruebas, identificar riesgos de producto y riesgos técnicos, mejorar nuestra estrategia de testing y trabajar estrechamente con desarrolladores, product managers y equipo de DevOps para prevenir los problemas en lugar de limitarse a detectarlos.

Este puesto es ideal para una persona que se desenvuelva bien en entornos colaborativos, que se anticipe a los retos antes de que surjan y que impulse las buenas prácticas en automatización y estrategias de testing.

Trabajarás en un producto digital de investigación de mercados disponible en tres plataformas: Android, iOS y extensiones de navegador.

¿Qué buscamos en ti?

Tus responsabilidades:

Investigación y reporte de defectos: Identificar, reproducir, investigar y documentar claramente los defectos, incluyendo su impacto, pasos para reproducirlos, logs/evidencias y el contexto técnico (JIRA). Colaborar con los desarrolladores para llevar las incidencias hasta su resolución y evitar que vuelvan a producirse.
Gestión de la cobertura de pruebas:
Revisar de forma proactiva la cobertura de pruebas manuales y automatizadas, identificando y cubriendo cualquier vacío existente.
Estrategia y responsabilidad sobre la automatización:
Definir las estrategias, frameworks y herramientas de automatización para maximizar la cobertura y la eficiencia de las pruebas automatizadas. Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener scripts de automatización robustos, escalables y reutilizables para pruebas de API, UI e integración.
Mejora proactiva de procesos:
Analizar y mejorar los procesos de QA, identificando carencias y proponiendo mejoras antes de que afecten a la calidad del producto, fomentando una cultura de calidad desde las primeras fases del desarrollo.
Colaboración y comunicación transversal:
Participar activamente con product managers, desarrolladores, DevOps y otros stakeholders para asegurar que la calidad esté presente en todas las fases del desarrollo.
CI/CD y fiabilidad de las pruebas:
Configurar y optimizar pipelines de ejecución automatizada de pruebas dentro de entornos CI/CD, garantizando un feedback rápido y resultados fiables y consistentes.

Principales aptitudes y habilidades:

Mentalidad proactiva: con iniciativa y capacidad para anticiparse a los desafíos y actuar antes de que se conviertan en problemas.
Capacidad para liderar con el ejemplo y promover la mejora continua de la calidad.
Capacidad para equilibrar la velocidad de entrega con el nivel de testing adecuado en función del riesgo.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para liderar conversaciones entre equipos y cuestionar decisiones o planteamientos cuando sea necesario.
Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente manteniendo informados y alineados a los miembros del equipo y a los stakeholders sobre los riesgos y bloqueos relevantes.
Mentalidad analítica y gran atención al detalle.
Disposición para aprender nuevas técnicas y tecnologías.
Nivel de inglés conversacional.

Imprescindibles

Sólidos conocimientos de QA: capacidad para evaluar los riesgos del producto, definir estrategias de testing adecuadas, diseñar casos de prueba efectivos, identificar carencias en la cobertura de pruebas y aplicar enfoques de testing exploratorio y basado en riesgos.
Sólida experiencia en análisis y resolución de defectos: capacidad para reproducir problemas, analizar fallos, analizar la causa y comunicar los defectos de forma clara
Más de 3 años de experiencia en QA/testing, con experiencia práctica en automatización de pruebas.
Sólidos conocimientos de programación/scripting en al menos un lenguaje (Java, Kotlin, TypeScript/JavaScript, etc.).
Experiencia práctica en testing de aplicaciones en Android e iOS, utilizando tanto dispositivos físicos como emuladores/simuladores, incluyendo pruebas de permisos, comportamiento de la aplicación en diferentes condiciones de conectividad y escenarios específicos de cada plataforma.
Experiencia práctica en automatización de pruebas web y/o móviles utilizando herramientas como Playwright, Selenium, Appium o equivalentes
Buen conocimiento del testing de APIs, bases de datos y CI/CD, incluyendo validación de APIs, SQL básico e integración de pruebas automatizadas en pipelines CI/CD.
Buen manejo de Git y de los flujos de trabajo habituales de desarrollo

Se valorará

Experiencia en testing de extensiones de navegador, permisos, compatibilidad entre navegadores y procesos de instalación/actualización.
Experiencia con JIRA, Confluence y Testmo.
Familiaridad con Docker y plataformas cloud como AWS.
Experiencia en pruebas de rendimiento/carga, BDD/Cucumber, accesibilidad, seguridad o pruebas visuales.

¿Qué te ofrecemos en Netquest?

Seguro médico privado de cuadro médico o reembolso (cobertura del 50% a cargo de la empresa).
Plan de retribución flexible: cheques o tarjeta restaurante, transporte y guardería.
Horario laboral flexible: entrada entre las 8:00 y las 10:00, y salida entre las 17:00 y las 19:00. Jornada intensiva los viernes, con salida adelantada entre las 14:00 y las 15:00.
Modelo híbrido de trabajo: 2 días en la oficina y el resto desde casa (teletrabajo).
Fruta fresca y café de calidad siempre disponibles en la oficina.
Entorno colaborativo e enfocado en la innovación. Cultura de aprendizaje continuo y de compartir conocimiento.
Oportunidades para influir en la estrategia y arquitectura de datos a nivel de toda la compañía.

Un equipo diverso para un mundo global

En Netquest, estamos comprometidos con la creación de un entorno de trabajo diverso e inclusivo. Damos la bienvenida a candidaturas de todos los orígenes y experiencias, y no discriminamos por motivos de raza, color, religión, género, orientación sexual, identidad de género, origen nacional, edad, discapacidad o cualquier otra condición protegida por la ley.

¿Quiénes somos?

En Netquest, transformamos el futuro a través de los datos.
Somos líderes globales en soluciones de investigación de mercados. Si te apasiona la innovación y quieres formar parte de un equipo internacional donde el talento y el crecimiento inspiran todo lo que hacemos, ¡te estamos buscando!

.

Senior Systems Engineer

Summary

Location:
Barcelona (Hybrid)
Rate:
Negotiable
Duration:
12 Months

About the Client

Our client is a global technology and communications organisation providing mission-critical digital infrastructure and services to the aviation industry. Its technology supports airlines, airports and other aviation stakeholders across a highly distributed international environment, where reliability, scalability and operational resilience are essential.
As part of a major technology modernisation initiative, the business is evolving its platforms for monitoring, observability, provisioning and configuration management. This role will contribute to that transformation, working with engineering teams across Europe and North America.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Senior System Engineer to contribute to the modernisation of next-generation Datalink observability, monitoring, provisioning and configuration management platforms.
Based in Barcelona and working collaboratively with an international engineering team, you will contribute specialist technical expertise to the definition, architecture, design and implementation of complex software and platform capabilities.
The role requires someone who can operate autonomously, bring proven industry experience to complex technical challenges, and contribute across the full engineering lifecycle from concept and system definition through to production implementation.

Key Responsibilities:

System Engineering
Platform Modernisation
Technical Collaboration
Strategic Outcomes

Contractor Working Arrangement

The engagement is structured around the delivery of defined technical services and project outcomes.
Due to the collaborative and operational nature of the project, the services are expected to include approximately three days per week working from the project site in Barcelona, with the remaining services capable of being delivered remotely where appropriate. The on-site requirement reflects the operational and collaborative needs of the project, including access to relevant teams, technical environments and project activities.
The contractor will retain professional autonomy over the manner in which the services are delivered, subject to agreed project requirements, deliverables, security, confidentiality and site-access arrangements. The engagement is for the provision of specialist technical services and is not intended to create an employment relationship between the contractor and the client.

What we are looking for

Required Experience

• 10+ years' experience as a Senior System Engineer, Senior Software Engineer or equivalent technical role within complex software, platform or technology environments.
• Strong experience with observability and monitoring ecosystems, including Grafana Labs technologies such as Alloy, Loki, Mimir or Prometheus, Grafana and OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP).
• Proven experience in platform or network system integration, monitoring, configuration management, APIs, microservices and scalable backend systems.
• Strong expertise in software architecture, distributed systems, enterprise application development and modern programming paradigms and frameworks.
• Strong problem-solving capability, with the ability to lead and coordinate technical discussions across complex engineering environments.
• Experience working effectively within international and geographically distributed engineering teams.
• Proven ability to work autonomously, take ownership of technical deliverables and operate effectively with limited day-to-day direction.
• Proficiency in leveraging AI-powered tools to support requirements management, static analysis, test automation, documentation and software engineering activities.

Preferred Experience

• Experience within aviation, telecommunications, networking or other mission-critical technology environments.
• Knowledge of operational support systems, configuration management and service management environments.
• Familiarity with technologies and standards such as ServiceNow.
• Experience with container orchestration and modern observability ecosystems.
• Experience working within globally distributed engineering organisations.
• Hands-on experience integrating AI-powered tools into system definition, architecture, design and development.

jobs.description:
Acerca del empleo

El Enterprise IT Systems Engineer es responsable de la ejecución técnica de proyectos tecnológicos en casa de cliente (On-Prem), asegurando la correcta implementación, configuración y soporte de las soluciones definidas. You will work across CI/CD, cloud, container orchestration, and security — bridging the gap between development, operations, and security teams so that releases are fast, repeatable, and secure.

Your growth and wellbeing are priorities. We offer continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a collaborative culture where we win together.
